name: cklph
description: Peter's personal Claude OS marketplace — authoritative skills, hooks, agents, and conventions.

plugins.name: cklph-os
plugins.description: Peter's personal Claude OS — authoritative skills, hooks, and conventions.

plugins.name: cklph-nextjs
plugins.description: Peter's opinionated Next.js + Supabase patterns. House style on top of the framework, complements vercel:* skills.

plugins.name: cklph-regression-watch
plugins.description: Baseline a live or staging site, re-check on demand or on a schedule, and surface only confirmed regressions (availability, SEO, tracking tag-firing, visual, journeys) with the evidence attached. On-demand, agent-interpreted; you own the data.

plugins.name: cklph-wp
plugins.description: Drive WordPress from Claude Code via wp-cli over SSH — connection to managed hosts (Flywheel/WP Engine/generic), posts/meta/options/media, and the hard-won hosting gotchas. Foundation for cklph-elementor and cklph-figma-to-wp.

plugins.name: cklph-elementor
plugins.description: Read and write Elementor page/template data programmatically — the _elementor_data model, the CSS/responsive gotchas, theme-builder templates + conditions, and the global Kit. Builds on cklph-wp.

plugins.name: cklph-figma
plugins.description: Read designs from the Figma MCP — design context, screenshots, structure metadata, and design tokens (colors, type, spacing). The design-source layer for any Figma-to-code work.

plugins.name: cklph-visual-qa
plugins.description: Verify a rendered web page VISUALLY against a design — headless-Chrome screenshots + ImageMagick crop/compare, overflow probes, and the adversarial visual-reviewer. Framework-agnostic; pairs with cklph-figma.

plugins.name: cklph-figma-to-wp
plugins.description: Orchestrate the full Figma to WordPress/Elementor pipeline: read the design, learn existing-page conventions, tokenize, generate Elementor JSON, write to a draft, and visually verify against Figma. Thin glue over cklph-figma, cklph-elementor, cklph-wp, and cklph-visual-qa.

plugins.name: cklph-audit
plugins.description: Comprehensive, adversarially-verified, agentic whole-repo security suite. Twelve lenses (security, correctness, architecture, sca, iac, container, k8s, supply-chain, compliance, concurrency, state-machine, economic) × opt-in docs-drift + omission + agent-config (the AI tooling layer, static). Phases: Discover → Recon → Map → Review → Verify → DAST (opt-in) → Reconcile → Variant → Patch (opt-in) → Synthesize → SelfReview. Deterministic-tool recall (Semgrep, Trivy, Grype, Syft, Checkov, Kubescape, gitleaks) → LLM judgment → adversarial verify (evidence-arbitrated, reachability traces) → optional exploit-to-confirm in sandbox (CodeMender core) → optional patch generation + validation (test + re-exploit + LLM-judge) → adversarial self-review of the report. SOC 2 + CASA compliance matrix, opt-in HIPAA rulebook. Manual feed-freshness checks (refresh-feeds). Optional MCP vulnerability intelligence enrichment (cve-mcp + vuln-intel-ext) for SCA lens. Read-only by default; DAST/Exploit/Patch are opt-in and sandboxed.

plugins.name: cro-research-reporting
plugins.description: Audit conversion funnels, run deep sourced research, write conversion copy and outbound/positioning, and produce render-safe reports + annotated redesign blueprints. Chykalophia CRO toolkit.

plugins.name: vuln-intel-ext
plugins.description: Sidecar MCP server extending cve-mcp with diff_since (what new CVEs hit my deps since my last scan), dependency snapshots, feed status, and WordPress vulnerability lookup. Powered by OSV.dev (30+ ecosystems, no API key required).
